decisions.label: Leaf hue jitter (degrees)
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves turned up to this many degrees of hue either way from its baked variant's, by a seed of its own (Ed, 2026-10-16: "a small amount of per-tree colour jitter"). 0: every tree of a variant the same, as before; 5 was measured too faint to see at night; past about 12 a tree can start to read as another season.

decisions.label: Leaf brightness jitter
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves brightened or darkened by up to this share, by a seed of its own. 0: none.
